messages.content: Recommend a report for the supplied fictional simulator under its stated decision objective. Return only the requested JSON answer.

Complete the acquisition decision for this fictional case.

Fictional case: fictional navigation waypoint simulator. A hidden state Z is either 0 or 1. Exactly one report must be purchased before observing its binary signal; then take the optimal ACT or WAIT action for that signal. Minimize expected terminal loss plus acquisition cost, in the same artificial score units. ACT has zero loss in state 1; WAIT has zero loss in state 0. Acquisition cost is paid for either signal. No other action or purchase is available.

Sensitivity is P(signal + | Z=1); specificity is P(signal - | Z=0). Report characteristics below are independently verified. Both reports arrive in the same fully readable canonical-English interface, with equal delivery time and effort and no additional fees.

Loss ACT in state 0: 24
Loss WAIT in state 1: 8

Report B: sensitivity=11/20; specificity=4/5; acquisition_cost=2

Report A: 104/25
Report B: 149/25
